profile.text:
Shining is a Sarkaz medic, a former member of the Sarkaz medic group 'Confessarii' and current member of the infected assistance group, 'Followers.' She is an authority in fields such as Originium Arts, field medicine, medical theories, and clinical medicine. 
She is now a Medic Operator at Rhodes Island, contributing her knowledge on Originium Arts theories and providing medical support for many an operation.
